defiscan.summary: Uniswap V3 is an automated market maker built around concentrated liquidity, where LP positions are issued as NFTs by the NonfungiblePositionManager and traded against pools deployed by the UniswapV3Factory. Governance runs through Compound Governor Bravo: UNI holders propose and vote on-chain (2.5M UNI to propose, 40M UNI quorum, ~7-day voting window), and successful proposals execute after a 48-hour Timelock delay. The minter role on the UNI token is held by the Timelock, with minting limited to 2% of supply per year and a 365-day minimum interval between mints — both limits are hardcoded in the token contract.

The protocol fee take is hard-capped: each per-direction fee divisor must be 0 or in [4, 10], bounding the protocol's share to at most 25% of LP swap fees. V3OpenFeeAdapter…

details.name: Firepit
details.description: Immutable — Accumulates UNI tokens from the TokenJar and periodically burns them by sending to the dead address (0x...dEaD) once a configurable threshold is reached. Firepit is Timelock-owned; governance controls the threshold amount (setThreshold) and the thresholdSetter role. It holds no LP or user funds.

risklayer.summary: Uniswap is the dominant multi-chain DEX with roughly $2.9B TVL across 40+ EVM chains, operating immutable v2/v3/v4 AMM contracts that have processed trillions in volume with no recorded core exploit since v2 launched in 2020. Core contract security is strong—non-upgradeable pools, nine pre-launch v4 audits, and an active $15.5M bug bounty—but governance and integration risks are elevated: an EOA controls Arbitrum v4 admin outside the Ethereum timelock, v4 hooks have caused ~$20M in third-party losses, and UNI voting power is concentrated in a 272M-token treasury and a small delegate set. Overall risk is moderate at 4.3/10.

This address can call setProtocolFeeController() and transferOwnership() per verified PoolManager source. Single-key compromise could reassign protocol-fee authority or ownership without timelock/multisig protect…

keyFindings.title: Same EOA controls Unichain v2 feeToSetter
keyFindings.description: The same EOA 0x2bad8182c09f50c8318d769245bea52c32be46cd is feeToSetter on Unichain UniswapV2Factory (0x1f9840…002), granting setFeeTo/setFeeToSetter privileges per verified v2 factory source. Cross-chain concentration of privileged roles in one EOA expands blast radius beyond Arbitrum v4.

keyFindings.description: Pipeline verification flags four contracts as unverified: Ethereum NonfungiblePositionManager (0xC36442b4…), Ethereum Timelock (0x1a9C8182…), Optimism UniswapV3Factory (0x1F98431c…), and Base Permit2 (0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3). keyFindings.title: v4 Hook Composability Creates Third-Party Integration Risk
keyFindings.description: v4 PoolManager delegates swap, liquidity, and donate lifecycle to arbitrary IHooks contracts chosen per pool. PoolManager correctly passes msg.sender to hook callbacks and prevents hook self-calls, but does not enforce onlyPoolManager on hook entrypoints—third-party hooks must implement access control themselves. Cork Protocol lost ~$12M (May 2025) when CorkHook.beforeSwap lacked PoolManager-only…

keyFindings.title: v4 hooks delegate execution to arbitrary pool-configured contracts
keyFindings.description: Verified PoolManager source invokes hook contracts at initialize, modifyLiquidity, swap, and donate via before/after hooks with optional delta returns. Core enforces hook-address bit flags but does not constrain hook logic. keyFindings.title: Permit2 is immutable and ownerless but aggregates token approvals
keyFindings.description: Verified Permit2 source shows no owner/admin/pause functions — deployment is immutable. Users granting Permit2 max approvals enable signature-based transfers via any integrated router. This is by design but creates a high-value phishing/approval-theft target; Base deployment is additionally unverified on BaseScan despite CREATE2 canonical address.

keyFindings.title: Timelock Contract Source Unverified on Etherscan
keyFindings.description: The UNI timelock at 0x1a9C8182C09F50C8318d769245beA52c32BE35BC has no verified source code on Etherscan. On-chain storage confirms Compound-style layout (admin=Governor Bravo, delay=172800s/2 days), but unverified bytecode prevents independent audit of the full execution logic and queued-transaction handling.
